03512 ka'ah {kaw-aw'}

字根型; TWOT - 941; 動詞

欽定本 - sad 1, broken 1, grieved 1; 3

1) 失望, 沮喪, 被威嚇
   1a) (Niphal) 沮喪, 被恫嚇 (#詩109:16;但11:30|)
   1b) (Hiphil) 使沮喪 (#結13:22|)
record.edic_text:
03512 ka'ah {kaw-aw'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 941; v

AV - sad 1, broken 1, grieved 1; 3

1) to be sad, be disheartened, be cowed
   1a) (Niphal) to be disheartened, be cowed
   1b) (Hiphil) to make sad
